user_return_objective_verbatim: 一年内，能涨多少涨多少
research_interpretation: Seek higher net returns over twelve months subject to the stated loss tolerance; do not optimize unconstrained upside or treat tolerance as money to spend.
loss_reference_assumption: Net loss from initial capital, adjusted for external deposits and withdrawals; not peak-to-trough drawdown.
required_research: Audit corporate-action accounting and executable prices before relying on historical returns.
Evaluate 300000 CNY sizing with costs, liquidity, lot constraints and realistic execution.
Report independent out-of-sample economics, rolling twelve-month outcomes, drawdowns and stress losses; historical outcomes do not bound future loss.
Define operational risk thresholds separately before any live pilot; stated loss tolerance alone is not a trading policy.
